name: Funk synth talk box lead
about: A fat, slightly driven funk synth slides after your voice on dorian notes while your mouth shapes every word.

name: Talk box on a chord
about: A lush minor seventh chord says your words, held under every syllable.

name: Talk box chord changes
about: Your words ride a slow loop of jazzy ninth chords that change every bar.

name: Talk box funk riff with echo
about: A busy funk riff plays in time while your mouth turns it into words, with an echo on the off beats.

name: Talk box arpeggio
about: A bright arpeggio climbs a major chord in time, bouncing between your ears as you talk.

name: Blues fuzz guitar talk box
about: A fuzzed-out guitar sings your words on blues notes, with a quick slap of echo right behind it.

name: Church organ talk box
about: A big low organ chord speaks your words and rings around the stone walls of a church.

name: Eight-bit talk box
about: A buzzing game console lead runs a quick arpeggio while your mouth makes the words.

name: Bass talk box
about: A round synth bass walks under your words, low and squashed like a funk record.

name: Square lead talk box
about: A hollow square lead glides high between the notes of a major scale as you speak.

name: Fuzz power chord talk box
about: A low, roaring guitar power chord is shaped into your words in a garage.

name: Talk box on one note
about: One deep held synth note mouths your words like a droning robot singer.

name: Vocoder synth lead
about: The classic robot synth voice: a bright saw lead plays your words on one note.

name: Vocoder strings
about: A wide string-machine chord sings your words in a soft shimmering hall.

name: Vocoder choir pad
about: A choir of synthetic voices sings your words on a floating suspended chord.

name: Vocoder organ
about: A churchy organ seventh chord says your words, swirling slowly in a rotating speaker.

name: Power chord robot vocoder
about: A low hollow power chord speaks for you with a little grit, like an arena robot.

name: Wide breath vocoder
about: Your words carved out of rushing noise and spread wide, a breathy machine whisper with no pitch at all.

name: Gated pulse vocoder
about: A thin pulse chord plays your words chopped into a trance rhythm.

name: Big open chord vocoder
about: A huge low stack of detuned saws sings your words like a film score.

name: Deep octave vocoder
about: A rumbling saw in low octaves, few bands and slow, like a giant speaking machine.

name: Eight-band retro vocoder
about: An early boxy vocoder with only eight bands: chunky, buzzy and only just readable.

name: Crisp hi-fi vocoder
about: Sixty-four bands and sharp consonants: a clean modern vocoder on a bright major chord.

name: Wind vocoder
about: The wind itself howls your words, on a cold hilltop.

name: Spoken by the rain
about: Falling rain forms your words, drop by drop, out in a downpour.

name: Spoken by a crowd
about: The murmur of a crowded hall shapes itself into your words.

name: Half you, half thunder
about: Your voice poured into rolling thunder, half words and half storm.

name: Backwards gong swell
about: Your words ring through a big gong, each one swelling in backwards before it lands.

name: Rain that swells with your words
about: Rain grows heavier while you speak and eases off in every pause.

name: Ring-modulated by an engine
about: An idling engine throbs through your voice, then a ring of metal clangs on top.

name: Words roared by a bonfire
about: Crackling flames roar your words beside a big bonfire.

name: Spoken by the waves
about: Breaking waves wash in and out in the shape of your words on a beach.

name: Words made of organ
about: A pipe organ chord is sculpted into your words, then fills a stone church.

name: Words rung on bells
about: A peal of bells shapes itself into each word and rings on after.

name: Engine that runs while you talk
about: A rumbling motor starts up with every phrase and cuts out when you stop.

name: Warm pad that swells with you
about: A soft synth pad blooms behind your voice as you speak and fades in the gaps.

name: Drone that bows to your voice
about: A low drone hums all the time and dips politely under every word you say.

name: Wind harp on a hilltop
about: Wind blows through your words and across harp strings tuned to an open chord, so the gusts sing.

name: Half you, half bells
about: Your voice and a ring of bells share one shape, so the bells seem to breathe.

name: Talk box on your own sound
about: Give it any recording and your mouth shapes it into words, like a talk box.

name: Vocoder on your own sound
about: Any sound you give it plays your words, through a forty-band vocoder.

name: Your words made of your sound
about: Your words spoken by the sound you choose, a song, a dog, a blender, anything.

name: Voice poured into your sound
about: Your voice rings through the sound you pick, as if it had its own body.

name: Your sound swells as you talk
about: The sound you pick rises while you talk and sinks in every pause.

name: Half you, half your sound
about: Your voice and the sound you choose melt into one, shaped by both.

name: Ring-modulated by your sound
about: Your voice multiplied by the sound you choose, a clanging metallic mash of both.

name: Church bells
about: Every word strikes a big bronze bell that hums on into a stone church.

name: Glass harmonica
about: Your voice rubs the rims of singing glasses, pure and wavering, in a soft room.

name: Low singing bowl
about: A big, low brass singing bowl hums and beats slowly under every word you say.

name: Struck temple gong
about: Each syllable hits a deep gong that shimmers out across a cathedral.

name: Wind chimes on the porch
about: Metal chimes tinkle with your words and drift side to side in a breeze.

name: Steel drum
about: Bright steel pan notes ring out on every word with a quick slap of echo.

name: Music box
about: Tiny steel tines plink high along with your voice inside a little wooden box.

name: Theatre thunder sheet
about: A huge stage thunder sheet rumbles and clangs with each word, a slow swirl running through it.

name: Handbell choir
about: A table of small high bells rung by several hands every time you speak.

name: Ice crystal chimes
about: Only the brightest notes of your voice freeze into ringing ice that rises in a shimmer.

name: Ringing chord comb
about: Your voice is tuned through a ringing major chord, a metallic choir in a soft hall.

name: Wooden marimba bars
about: Warm wooden bars knock and hum under every syllable you speak.

name: Hollow wooden box drum
about: You talk into a box drum and every word thumps its hollow wooden body.

name: Long hollow tube
about: Your voice hoots down a long open pipe that hums its own low notes.

name: Blowing across a bottle
about: Your words become breath whistling over the neck of a glass bottle.

name: Didgeridoo-like drone
about: A deep buzzing drone through a long wooden tube, your words riding on top.

name: Wooden tongue drum
about: Low round wooden tongues ring softly with your words in a big quiet room.

name: Plucked harp strings
about: High harp strings are plucked with every word and ring along with your voice.

name: Sitar-like buzzing strings
about: Drone strings buzz against a curved bridge and shimmer around your voice.

name: Concert grand, pedal down
about: You talk into a concert grand with the sustain pedal held, and its low strings ring back in the hall.

name: Dark minor harp
about: Low, soft-plucked minor strings follow every word like a sad ballad.

name: Open fifths drone strings
about: Low open fifths ring on and on behind you and rise in a heavenly shimmer.

name: Bright zither
about: Sharp high strings snap with a hard pick and a little bridge buzz on every syllable.

name: Twelve-string shimmer
about: Octave strings strummed in pairs, wide and chorused like a jangly guitar.

name: Minor seventh strings
about: A mellow jazzy minor seventh chord rings and trembles under your words.

name: Bowed minor strings
about: A section of bowed strings swells along with you on a minor chord, with gentle vibrato.

name: Spooky cluster harp
about: Clashing harp strings in a tight cluster jangle eerily after every word.

name: Organ through a rotating speaker
about: A drawbar organ plays your words while the speaker cabinet spins up to full speed.

name: Cathedral pipe organ
about: A huge low organ chord speaks your words and rolls around a cathedral.

name: Fairground organ
about: A bright wheezing band organ plays your words at a busy fair at night.

name: Electric piano dream
about: Soft electric piano tines ring with your voice, wobbling gently from ear to ear.

name: Toy piano
about: Plinky little piano notes ring out of a tiny plastic speaker.

name: Wheezy squeezebox
about: A reedy accordion-like chord breathes in and out as it says your words.

name: Bass synth
about: A deep filtered saw bass plays your words like a low robot groove.

name: Theremin-like glide
about: A thin eerie tone swoops and wavers along with the tune of your voice.

name: Trance supersaw lead
about: Huge detuned saws say your words on the offbeat with echoes trailing behind.

name: Squelchy acid bass
about: A rubbery low saw squelches and squeals as a filter opens on your loud words.

name: Synth brass stabs
about: Punchy saw-brass power chords stab out each word with a gated room burst.

name: Wobbling bass synth
about: A low octave saw bass wobbles as a resonant filter swings open and shut.

name: Arcade arpeggio singer
about: Your speech races up and down a chord in crunchy four-bit sound, like an old arcade tune.

name: Chip lead that follows you
about: A buzzy game-console pulse sings your tune on a major scale, then gets crunched.

name: Singing musical saw
about: A pure bending tone slides between every note you speak with a wide, weepy vibrato.

name: Frozen voice pad
about: Moments of your voice are caught and held ringing into a soft frozen pad.

name: Endless ambient pad
about: Your words stretched four times longer into a slow, glowing cloud of sound.

name: Four-part choir of you
about: Four extra singers made from your voice fill out a big chord in a stone church.

name: Angel pad shimmer
about: Your voice rises in octaves and fifths into a smeared, heavenly halo.

name: Humming drone pad
about: Your voice tuned to one low note and smeared into a humming drone.

name: Grain cloud choir
about: Your voice scattered into long overlapping grains that float like a soft choir.

name: Kazoo band
about: A whole buzzing kazoo band plays along with you in the living room.

name: Comb and paper busker
about: Tissue paper on a comb buzzes out your tune on a street corner while the city goes by.

name: Big and small kazoo duet
about: A tuba-sized kazoo and a tiny one blart out your words together, an octave apart.

name: Droning mouth harp
about: A twangy jaw harp holds one droning note and boings and wahs through everything you say.

name: Twangy rubber band
about: Low slack strings boing and wobble like a rubber band plucked with every word.

name: Jug band blower
about: Your buzzing lips boom into a big clay jug like an old porch band.
